mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals a tight labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production signals a strong supply environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between GDP growth rate and housing starts signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth and housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between the federal funds rate and the consumer price index signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% and an increase in payroll employment signal a tight labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low unemployment and strong payroll employment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate and a rise in housing starts signal a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during late-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth and housing starts in late-cycle expansions (t-test p > 0.05).
